title: Run dev-time headline-source analysis against the current cache export
_comment: Executable run configuration for exploratory headline/source analysis. This is run-once measurement work, not part of the publish/build pipeline. Edit values here instead of maintaining long command lines.

invariants.no_build_integration: Do not run the analysis in scripts/build.js, CI, or the normal digest pipeline without explicit approval. The frozen measured-sources.json export may be copied as static site data for the measured-sources page.
invariants.no_large_models: Use local classical/NLP tooling only; no transformer downloads or GPU-dependent models.
invariants.not_truth_scores: Outputs are title-language diagnostics and ordering aids, not factual accuracy or publisher-quality verdicts.
invariants.preserve_raw_axes: Keep per-headline and per-axis rates inspectable; composite ordering is supplementary.
